_: KEY-EXACT JOINS (package I, I7d, 2026-10-18), read by scripts/migration/build-map.mjs. A record the stage-1 matcher filed on ANOTHER record's page by name (map.json how "slug-noparen": the bare name without its parenthesis) is joined here to its own Archives page, so map.json names that page, stamp-aonid.mjs stamps it as aonId and backfill-ast-edition.mjs draws its popup from it. A JOIN fix, not an overlay aonId pin: a pin keeps the join's page as joinDocId, which scripts/import-core-v2.mjs mapDocFor builds a record from (build-map.mjs's trait|Metamagic entry says the same). Keyed by bucket/key, not by name: the name is what matched the wrong page. All four are kept orphans today (no export page slugs to their key), so import-core-v2.mjs builds their facets and prose from the Foundry reference and never reads the join; build-map.mjs refuses an entry whose record the importer built from another page (used-docs.json), names a page the export does not hold, or names a record core.json does not hold. Each why cites the page.

feats/roll-with-it-kingmaker.why: feat-3903 is "Roll with It (Ranger)", Kingmaker Companion Guide pg. 23 — the record's own feat (traits ranger, level 12, prose "Your hunted prey, which must be a giant, hits you with a melee attack"). The matcher stamped feat-1009 by name: the goblin feat "Roll with It (Goblin)", Character Guide pg. 39, which feats/roll-with-it carries.

conditions/aon-concealed-army.why: condition-44 is "Concealed (Army)", Kingmaker Adventure Path pg. 582 — the record's own condition (prose "A concealed army is tougher to target"). The matcher stamped condition-62 by name: the Player Core "Concealed" condition, which conditions/concealed carries.

feats/quick-recovery.why: feat-7004 is "Quick Recovery (Yaoguai)", Tian Xia Character Guide pg. 87 — the record's own feat (traits yaoguai, level 9, Frequency once per day, prose "You use your command over your form to repair" … "Reduce your wounded condition by 1."). The matcher stamped feat-3923 by name: the kingdom feat "Quick Recovery (Kingdom)", Kingmaker Adventure Path pg. 532, which feats/quick-recovery-kingdom carries.

feats/the-harder-they-fall.why: feat-4938 is "The Harder They Fall (Rogue)", Player Core pg. 172 — the record's own feat (traits rogue, level 4, prose "When you successfully Trip an off-guard foe"). The matcher stamped feat-3901 by name: the ranger feat "The Harder They Fall (Ranger)", Kingmaker Companion Guide pg. 23, which feats/the-harder-they-fall-kingmaker carries.
